exampleEn: It's time to break the norm and try something new.
exampleKo: 이제 규범에서 벗어나 새로운 것을 시도할 때입니다.
gameExamples: Young artists often strive to break the norm in their creative expressions.
In order to innovate, we must be willing to break the norm and take risks.
She decided to break the norm by pursuing her passion instead of a traditional career path.
